empty.title: This artist is a performer, not a songwriter
empty.body: Their income comes from their own streams: read it on Revenue and French rights. This page is for those whose work mostly happens on other people's records.

undeclared.title: Not registered with SACEM
undeclared.caption: money that won't come in until it is
undeclared.sub: {count, plural, one {# released work is not registered} other {# released works are not registered}}: SACEM cannot pay on a work it doesn't know about.

pipeline.title: The order book
pipeline.caption: signed or pitched — not a euro yet
pipeline.legend: A signed work has a date; a pitch has an intention. We don't add them up: the second is not future income.
pipeline.simulated: Demo works: titles, performers, dates and shares are made up.

table.title: Work by work
table.caption: writer share · production points
table.method: Gross master = streams × blended French rate × territory coefficient. Publishing = gross × 27.3 % (authors' rights: 15 for every 55 paid to the master, GESAC 2022) × their writer share × the creators' share under Sacem rules: one third each to author, composer and publisher on performance rights, mechanicals per their publishing deal (58.3 % for streaming of a work published 50/50). Production = gross × their points. The territory is theirs, for lack of per-performer audience data: hence the “estimated” provenance.
table.provenance: Real: the titles and streams of released works (Spotify reading of 25/09/2026). Simulated: writer shares, production points, SACEM registrations and every unreleased work.

own.subtitle: Their works are their own songs: they write and perform them, so their author royalties follow their streams.

hero.title: Author royalties on their songs
hero.caption: last 12 months, same calculation as Revenue
hero.sub: performing songwriter signed in publishing · {streams} streams in 12 months

table.title: Song by song
table.caption: split pro rata to streams
table.method: Same calculation as the Revenue page: gross master × 27.3% (author rights, 15 for every 55 paid to the master, GESAC 2022) × the creators' share under Sacem rules. Until their share is entered, they count as the sole writer of their songs.

composers.title: The roster's non-performing composers
composers.body: They don't write for their own records: their streams depend on placements with other artists.
